newsitem.title: GERMANY: Wella sees return on sales improving.
newsitem.headline: Wella sees return on sales improving.

text.p: German haircare firm Wella AG's chief executive Joerg von Craushaar said on Tuesday that the group's return on sales would reach 4.0 percent in the year 2000.
Craushaar was speaking to a news conference held for the publication of Wella's 1996 full-year results.
In 1996, the group posted a return on sales of 2.0 percent.
For this year, Wella's chief financial officer Hans Schmidt said that performance would improve slightly.
"Our return on sales will be slightly higher in 1997, maybe around 2.2 percent," he told the news conference.
